newsitem.title: USA: Boeing in data talks with Lockheed Martin - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Boeing in data talks with Lockheed Martin - WSJ.

text.p: Rivals Boeing Co and Lockheed Martin Corp have agreed to negotiate an unusual private agreement intended to safeguard information they shared as partners, The Wall Street Journal said.

In Friday's electronic edition, the paper cited information from "executives familiar with the discussions" who said that following a string of acquisitions, the two companies will now compete in many areas of aerospace and defence.
Meanwhile they must also work together to make various military aircraft, weapons and space systems, the article said.
The pact would establish preset contractual "firewalls," substituting a private agreement for terms normally laid out in consent decrees issued by federal regulators, the article said.
Such terms, the Journal said, prohibit each company from using proprietary information already exchanged for the purpose of gaining a new competitive edge against the other.
The talks could take months to complete, the newspaper said.
